ready for Google Play (Unicode headings with 🌿 and bullets ▸, no markdown):\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e---\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eMeditation Time is a simple and powerful meditation timer designed to support your daily mindfulness practice. Set your meditation timer, choose a bell, singing bowl or gong, and meditate without distraction while gentle sounds mark the end of your session.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eThis meditation timer helps you stay fully present during meditation. Instead of checking the clock, you can relax into your practice and let the timer guide you.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e🌿 Meditation timer features\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e▸ Simple and flexible meditation timer\u003cbr\u003e▸ Beautiful meditation bells, singing bowls and gongs\u003cbr\u003e▸ Optional interval mindfulness chime to gently bring your attention back\u003cbr\u003e▸ Nature sounds as calming background during meditation\u003cbr\u003e▸ Guided meditations by professional speakers\u003cbr\u003e▸ Zen Mode with three ending chimes\u003cbr\u003e▸ Master Mode for long meditation sessions up to 4 hours\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eWith the optional interval chime, the meditation timer gently reminds you to return to the present moment whenever the mind starts to wander. This makes it easier to maintain awareness and deepen your meditation.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eIf your surroundings are noisy or your mind feels restless, the included nature sounds help create a calm atmosphere so you can focus on your meditation practice.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eOur guided meditations provide additional structure and motivation for your daily meditation routine. They are suitable for beginners as well as experienced practitioners.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e🌿 Reduce stress and anxiety with meditation\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eRegular meditation can help reduce stress, calm anxiety and improve concentration. Using a meditation timer helps you stay present without worrying about the time. Many people use meditation to relax after a stressful day, improve sleep or cultivate inner calm and balance.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eWhether you are completely new to meditation or already experienced, this meditation timer app helps you build a consistent and enjoyable practice.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e🌿 Learn the essentials of meditation\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eThe integrated teaching section offers a brief and accessible introduction to important aspects of meditation practice. It provides inspiration, guidance and motivation to help you develop a regular meditation habit.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e🌿 Meditation and mindfulness in everyday life\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eMeditation apps make it easier to integrate mindfulness into daily life. silent meditation timer that gets out of the way. No guided voices, no feed, no ads — just a bell, your breath, and the time you choose.\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eMost meditation apps want your attention. MindTime gives it back. Set a duration, pick a bell, and sit. When you finish, your streak, your stats and your journal are waiting — and nothing else is.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eBuilt for a real practice\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003eMindTime is the timer, not a content library. It is made for people who already sit: vipassana and insight meditation, zen and zazen, mindfulness and MBSR, samatha and anapanasati, metta, breathwork, yoga nidra — or simply sitting quietly for ten minutes a day.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eSilent by design\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eNo voices, ever:\u003c/b\u003e nothing talks over your session. No guided tracks, no teacher, no feed to scroll.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eVibration-only mode:\u003c/b\u003e feel your interval bells instead of hearing them — made for retreats, shared rooms, offices, dorms and late nights beside a sleeping partner.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eFully silent mode:\u003c/b\u003e or switch every sound off and let the session simply end.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eNo ads, no interruptions:\u003c/b\u003e nothing appears while you are sitting.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eYour timer, your way\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eAny duration:\u003c/b\u003e from seconds to hours — or endless mode with no time limit at all.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eWarm-up phase:\u003c/b\u003e settle in before the session really begins.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003ePresets:\u003c/b\u003e save your usual sit and start it with a single tap.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eFour session types:\u003c/b\u003e Meditation, Sleep, Focus and Relaxation, each with its own statistics.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eSix interval bells that bring you back\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eSix recorded bells:\u003c/b\u003e three Tibetan singing bowls (Manipuri, Jambati, Thadobati), a crystal bowl, a Hanchi gong and Koshi chimes.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eStart, interval and end bells:\u003c/b\u003e set each one separately — ring every 5 minutes, every 10, or at any interval you like.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eIndependent volumes:\u003c/b\u003e every bell has its own level, so nothing ever jolts you out of a sit.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eOr no bell at all:\u003c/b\u003e vibration only, or complete silence.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003e31 soundscapes — entirely optional\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eNoise:\u003c/b\u003e brown noise, light brown and intense brown noise, white noise, pink noise, green noise and blue noise.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eRain and nature:\u003c/b\u003e gentle rain, heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, rain on a van, ocean waves, a mountain river, forest birds and crackling fire.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eAmbient and frequency:\u003c/b\u003e zen garden stream, choir pad, cosmic space, 174 Hz, 285 Hz and 528 Hz.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eSilence is the default:\u003c/b\u003e mix a soundscape under your session only when you want one.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eBuild the habit\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eDaily streaks:\u003c/b\u003e see your consistency at a glance.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eReal statistics:\u003c/b\u003e total sessions, total minutes and average session length, broken down by type.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eWeekly view:\u003c/b\u003e the days you actually practiced.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eGentle reminders:\u003c/b\u003e stay on track without being nagged.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eReflect with a journal\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eSession notes:\u003c/b\u003e capture what came up while it is still fresh.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eHistory:\u003c/b\u003e browse back through weeks and months to notice patterns.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eOptional:\u003c/b\u003e turn journaling off in Settings and never see it again.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eDistraction-free by design\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eHide the clock:\u003c/b\u003e show or hide the countdown and the progress circle — some people focus better without a number.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eScreen stays on:\u003c/b\u003e your phone never interrupts a sit.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eGentle fade-out:\u003c/b\u003e eases you out of the session instead of cutting it off.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eCloud sync:\u003c/b\u003e presets, history and streaks stay in step across your devices.\u003cbr\u003e• \u003cb\u003eNo sign-up needed:\u003c/b\u003e open the app and start. No guided voices, no social feed — a beautiful, distraction-free timer that tracks your practice and quietly keeps you motivated.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eAn unguided meditation timer that adapts to you\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003eWhether you practise Vipassana, Zen, mindfulness, mantra, yoga or breathwork, Timefully fits your method — not the other way around. Create unlimited presets, each with its own segments: warm-up, meditation, interval bells and cool-down. Count up or count down, leave a session open-ended, or switch to simple mode for just the essentials. Keep separate profiles for different practices, each with its own presets, and give every preset its own background.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eBells worth sitting with\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003eChoose from 30+ bell types — Tibetan bells, prayer bowls, a crystal singing bowl, Chinese flutes and more. Set starting and ending bells (one to three rings), interval bells at fixed times or on repeat, a gentle fade-in, and the volume you want. Or sit in silence with haptic cues.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eSee your practice grow\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003eTimefully tracks every session automatically, and you can add past sessions by hand. Statistics and charts show your meditation across the week, month and year, alongside a monthly calendar and a word cloud drawn from your notes. After each sit, capture how you feel with emotion tracking — intensity included — and write down what you noticed.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cb\u003eMotivation that never gamifies the meditation itself\u003c/b\u003e\u003cbr\u003eSet daily and weekly goals, keep a streak, reach milestones and achievements, and grow a garden of trees — six species, from oak to wisteria — as your practice deepens. MUSIC\u003cbr\u003e━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eEnhance your meditation with your own audio.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003ePlay any music or sound stored on your device:\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• Nature sounds\u003cbr\u003e• Rain\u003cbr\u003e• Ocean waves\u003cbr\u003e• Binaural beats\u003cbr\u003e• Singing bowls\u003cbr\u003e• White noise\u003cbr\u003e• Personal playlists\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eYour music remains under your control—nothing is streamed or downloaded.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\u003cbr\u003e📋 CUSTOM PRACTICES\u003cbr\u003e━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eCreate personalised meditation practices that fit your routine.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eEach practice can include:\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e• Custom name\u003cbr\u003e• Session duration\u003cbr\u003e• Background music\u003cbr\u003e• Reminder settings\u003cbr\u003e• Personal preferences\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eLaunch your favourite practice with a single tap.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\u003cbr\u003e📝 SESSION NOTES \u0026amp;
